title: 高層建築差異縮短補償~Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings
focus: 預測柱與核心筒的彈性、潛變與收縮縮短差，並以標高預抬、延遲接合與監測回饋加以補償~Predicting elastic, creep and shrinkage shortening differences between columns and cores and compensating with level corrections, delayed connections and monitoring feedback
summary: 超高層的柱與核心筒在重力、潛變與收縮下持續縮短，若兩者縮短量不同，樓板會傾斜，連接構件與外伸臂會鎖入附加力，帷幕牆與電梯也會被拉扯。本課從縮短的三個來源與「安裝後縮短」的觀念出發，談構件尺寸、鋼—混凝土混合系統、標高補償、延遲接合時機、振弦式應變計與測量回饋，到非結構構件的容許變形與竣工後的長期追蹤，並以樂天世界塔、哈里發塔與世界貿易中心一號大樓的公開做法為例。~In a supertall building, columns and cores keep shortening under gravity, creep and shrinkage; when they shorten by different amounts, floors tilt, connecting members and outriggers lock in extra forces, and façades and elevators are strained. Starting from the three sources of shortening and the idea of post-installation shortening, the course covers member size, steel–concrete hybrid systems, level compensation, timing of delayed connections, vibrating-wire gauges and survey feedback, then tolerances of non-structural elements and long-term tracking after completion, illustrated by public practice at Lotte World Tower, Burj Khalifa and One World Trade Center.

units.anchor: 彈性、潛變與收縮應變~Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain
units.title: 縮短的三個來源~Three sources of shortening
units.mechanism: 混凝土豎向構件的縮短由三部分組成：加載時立即發生的彈性應變、在持續荷載下隨時間增加的潛變，以及與荷載無關、因水分散失而產生的收縮。潛變大致與應力成正比，通常以潛變係數 φ 乘上彈性應變表示；收縮則取決於濕度、構件尺寸與配比。周邊柱與核心牆的應力水準、斷面尺寸與加載時程不同，三部分加總後的總應變就不同，每層的差值會沿高度累積成數十毫米的差異縮短。~Shortening of vertical concrete members has three parts: elastic strain that occurs immediately on loading, creep that grows with time under sustained load, and shrinkage that is independent of load and results from moisture loss. Creep is roughly proportional to stress and is usually expressed as a creep coefficient φ times the elastic strain; shrinkage depends on humidity, member size and mix. Perimeter columns and core walls differ in stress level, section size and loading history, so the sum of the three strains differs, and the storey-by-storey difference accumulates up the height into tens of millimetres of differential shortening.
units.model: 總應變 ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh。柱：σ = 20 MPa、E = 40 GPa、φ = 1.5、ε_sh = 200 με → 500 + 750 + 200 = 1,450 με；核心牆：σ = 10 MPa、φ = 1.5、ε_sh = 300 με → 250 + 375 + 300 = 925 με。差值 525 με，在 4 m 層高等於每層約 2.1 mm。數值為教學假設。~Total strain ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh. For a column with σ = 20 MPa, E = 40 GPa, φ = 1.5 and ε_sh = 200 με: 500 + 750 + 200 = 1,450 με; for a core wall with σ = 10 MPa, φ = 1.5 and ε_sh = 300 με: 250 + 375 + 300 = 925 με. The 525 με difference is about 2.1 mm per 4 m storey. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以實際配比做潛變與收縮試驗（例如依 ASTM C512 與 C157），擬合潛變係數與收縮終值，代入預測模型；再比較 ACI 209、fib Model Code 與試驗擬合三種預測的差異，把差異範圍當作補償值的不確定性區間。~Run creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes, for example to ASTM C512 and C157, fit the creep coefficient and ultimate shrinkage and feed them into the prediction model; compare predictions from ACI 209, the fib Model Code and the test fit to define an uncertainty band.
units.failure: 若只計算彈性縮短而忽略潛變與收縮，長期差異縮短可能被低估兩到三倍，完工數年後周邊樓板仍持續下沉，電梯門檻與帷幕牆接縫逐漸超出調整範圍。~Computing only elastic shortening and ignoring creep and shrinkage can underestimate long-term differential shortening by two to three times, so perimeter floors keep dropping for years after completion and elevator sills and façade joints gradually run out of adjustment.
units.misconception: 柱子只在加載當下縮短，之後長度就不再改變。~A column shortens only at the moment of loading and its length then stays constant.
units.practice: 設計初期就把柱與核心牆的應力比列為控制目標，並在規範中要求以實際配比做潛變收縮試驗，試驗結果須在主要結構施工前回饋到預測模型。~Treat the column-to-core stress ratio as a design target from the outset, and require creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes in the specification, with results fed back into the prediction model before major structural work begins.

units.anchor: 安裝後縮短曲線~Post-installation shortening profile
units.title: 安裝後縮短與中段最大~Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height
units.mechanism: 逐層施工時，每一層樓板都是在下方已經縮短之後才依設計標高施作，因此真正影響樓板高程與連接構件的，是該層安裝之後才發生的縮短。底部樓層安裝早，但其下方柱段很短；頂部樓層下方柱段很長，但安裝時上面已沒有新增荷重；結果安裝後縮短在中段附近最大，這與一次加載模型「越往上越大」的直覺相反。補償值因此必須依樓層逐一計算，而不是按高度比例分配。~In storey-by-storey construction each floor is built to its design level after the structure below has already shortened, so what matters for floor levels and connecting members is the shortening that occurs after that floor is installed. Low floors are installed early but have little column below them; top floors have a long column below but receive almost no load after installation; post-installation shortening therefore peaks near mid-height, contrary to a one-step loading model in which shortening grows toward the top. Compensation must be computed floor by floor, not prorated by height.
units.model: 等斷面柱、每層荷重 P、每段勁度 k，第 i 層安裝後的彈性縮短 δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k。N = 100、P/k = 0.01 mm：δ₂₅ = 25×75×0.01 ≈ 18.8 mm，δ₅₀ = 25.0 mm（最大），δ₇₅ ≈ 18.8 mm，δ₁₀₀ = 0。數值為教學假設，未含時間相依效應。~For a uniform column with load P per floor and segment stiffness k, the elastic shortening after floor i is installed is δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k. With N = 100 and P/k = 0.01 mm: δ₂₅ = 25×75×0.01 ≈ 18.8 mm, δ₅₀ = 25.0 mm (maximum), δ₇₅ ≈ 18.8 mm and δ₁₀₀ = 0. Values are teaching assumptions without time-dependent effects.
units.verify: 以施工階段分析逐層啟動構件與荷重，輸出每層安裝後的縮短曲線，並以手算 i(N − i) 型式核對趨勢；施工中每隔數層以精密水準量測樓板相對於設計標高的偏差，檢查實測曲線形狀是否與預測一致。~Activate members and loads floor by floor in a construction-stage analysis and output the post-installation shortening profile, checking its trend against the hand-derived i(N − i) form; during construction, level-survey floor deviations from design elevations every few floors and check that the measured profile matches the predicted shape.
units.failure: 若以一次加載模型的結果做補償，頂部樓層會被過度預抬、中段補償不足，完工後頂部樓板高於設計、中段低於設計，電梯導軌與管道立管被迫在現場切改。~Compensating from a one-step loading model over-raises the top floors and under-compensates mid-height, leaving upper floors high and middle floors low after completion and forcing site modifications to elevator rails and risers.
units.misconception: 樓層越高，需要的縮短補償就越大。~The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs.
units.practice: 補償表應明確區分「總縮短」與「安裝後縮短」，並註明採用的施工速度假設；施工進度若明顯變快或變慢，須由結構工程師重新計算後續樓層的補償值。~Compensation tables must distinguish total from post-installation shortening and state the assumed construction speed; if progress becomes much faster or slower, the structural engineer must recalculate compensation for later floors.

units.anchor: 體表比與收縮速率~Volume-to-surface ratio and shrinkage
units.title: 構件尺寸對潛變收縮的影響~Effect of member size on creep and shrinkage
units.mechanism: 收縮與乾燥潛變需要水分從混凝土表面散失，所以構件的體積與表面積比（V/S）越大，水分路徑越長，收縮越慢、越小。粗大的周邊巨柱 V/S 大，薄核心牆 V/S 小，兩者即使用同一配比，收縮也可能差近一倍；牆的收縮甚至可能讓核心筒縮短得比柱更多。高強混凝土的潛變係數一般較低，但自體收縮較大，因此在不同高度改變強度或構件尺寸，都會改變差異縮短的方向與大小。~Shrinkage and drying creep require moisture to leave through the surface, so the larger a member's volume-to-surface ratio (V/S), the longer the moisture path and the slower and smaller the shrinkage. Massive perimeter mega-columns have high V/S and thin core walls low V/S, so even with the same mix their shrinkage can differ by nearly a factor of two, and wall shrinkage can make the core shorten more than the columns. High-strength concrete generally has a lower creep coefficient but higher autogenous shrinkage, so changing strength or member size at different heights changes both the direction and the size of differential shortening.
units.model: ACI 209 收縮的體表比修正 γ_vs = 1.2·exp(−0.00472·V/S)（V/S 以 mm 計）。1.5 m 方柱 V/S = 1,500²/(4×1,500) = 375 mm，γ_vs ≈ 0.204；500 mm 雙面乾燥的牆 V/S = 250 mm，γ_vs ≈ 0.369；牆的最終收縮約為柱的 1.8 倍。數值為教學假設。~ACI 209's volume-to-surface correction for shrinkage is γ_vs = 1.2·exp(−0.00472·V/S) with V/S in mm. A 1.5 m square column has V/S = 1,500²/(4×1,500) = 375 mm and γ_vs ≈ 0.204; a 500 mm wall drying on both faces has V/S = 250 mm and γ_vs ≈ 0.369, so the wall's ultimate shrinkage is about 1.8 times the column's. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 製作與實際構件同 V/S 的大型試體或在構件中埋設應變計，量測收縮發展曲線，與小型標準試體的結果比較，修正尺寸效應；混凝土強度或斷面改變的樓層須在預測模型中單獨分段。~Cast large specimens with the same V/S as real members, or embed gauges in the members, to measure shrinkage development and compare with small standard specimens to correct for size effect; floors where strength or section changes must be modelled as separate segments.
units.failure: 若以小試體的收縮直接套用到巨柱，會高估巨柱收縮、低估核心牆收縮，補償方向錯誤，完工後核心筒周邊樓板反而下傾，連接梁出現與預期相反的裂縫。~Applying small-specimen shrinkage directly to mega-columns overestimates column shrinkage and underestimates wall shrinkage, so compensation goes the wrong way: after completion floors slope down toward the core and link beams crack in the opposite sense to that expected.
units.misconception: 同一配比的混凝土無論做成牆或柱，收縮量都一樣。~The same concrete mix shrinks the same amount whether it is cast as a wall or a column.
units.practice: 預測報告應列出每個構件群組的 V/S、混凝土強度、加載齡期與採用的收縮潛變參數，並在施工中更換配比或構件尺寸時重新評估。~The prediction report should list V/S, concrete strength, loading age and the creep and shrinkage parameters for each member group, and be re-evaluated whenever mixes or member sizes change during construction.

units.anchor: 鋼柱與混凝土核心的混合系統~Steel columns with a concrete core
units.title: 鋼—混凝土混合系統的縮短差~Shortening mismatch in steel–concrete hybrids
units.mechanism: 許多超高層採用混凝土核心筒搭配鋼柱或鋼骨混凝土柱的混合系統。鋼柱沒有潛變與收縮，但服務應力高、彈性應變大；混凝土核心應力低，但會持續潛變收縮。哪一方縮短較多取決於兩者的數值，常見情況是核心筒在長期中縮短較多，與純混凝土塔樓的「柱縮短較多」方向相反。世界貿易中心一號大樓的核心混凝土配比同時針對強度、模數、潛變與收縮設計，就是為了讓核心筒的變形可被準確預測，與周邊鋼框架協調。~Many supertall towers combine a concrete core with steel or composite columns. Steel columns do not creep or shrink but carry high service stress and large elastic strain; the concrete core is less stressed but keeps creeping and shrinking. Which shortens more depends on the numbers, and often the core shortens more in the long term, the opposite of the column-shortens-more pattern of all-concrete towers. At One World Trade Center the core mixes were designed for strength, modulus, creep and shrinkage together precisely so that core deformation could be predicted accurately and coordinated with the perimeter steel frame.
units.model: 鋼柱 σ = 160 MPa、E = 200 GPa：ε = 800 με。混凝土核心 σ = 12 MPa、E = 38 GPa、φ = 2.0、ε_sh = 250 με：ε = 316 + 632 + 250 ≈ 1,197 με。差值約 397 με，在 250 m 高度累積約 99 mm，核心筒縮短較多。數值為教學假設。~A steel column at σ = 160 MPa with E = 200 GPa has ε = 800 με. A concrete core at σ = 12 MPa with E = 38 GPa, φ = 2.0 and ε_sh = 250 με has ε = 316 + 632 + 250 ≈ 1,197 με. The difference of about 397 με accumulates to about 99 mm over 250 m, with the core shortening more. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以時間相依的施工階段分析分別追蹤鋼柱與核心筒在每層安裝後的縮短，確認差異方向；鋼柱可在工廠依補償值調整柱長或在續接處加墊片，現場以水準量測核對每節柱頂標高。~Use time-dependent construction-stage analysis to track post-installation shortening of steel columns and core separately and confirm the direction of the difference; steel columns can be lengthened in the shop or shimmed at splices according to the compensation values, and each tier's column-top level is checked by site levelling.
units.failure: 若沿用純混凝土塔樓的經驗把鋼柱預抬，卻沒有發現核心筒才是縮短較多的一方，差異會加倍：周邊樓板高於核心，樓板梁端與外伸臂承受反向的附加力。~Raising steel columns out of habit from all-concrete towers, without noticing that the core is the one that shortens more, doubles the difference: perimeter floors end up higher than the core and beam ends and outriggers carry reversed additional forces.
units.misconception: 鋼柱沒有潛變，所以鋼—混凝土混合塔樓不會有差異縮短問題。~Steel columns do not creep, so steel–concrete hybrid towers have no differential-shortening problem.
units.practice: 混合系統的補償須同時規劃混凝土核心的澆置標高與鋼柱的工廠長度，兩者由同一份補償表管理，並在鋼柱製造前凍結當節的補償值。~In hybrid systems plan concrete core casting levels and steel column shop lengths together from one compensation table, freezing each tier's values before the columns are fabricated.

units.anchor: 澆置與安裝標高預抬~Casting and erection level corrections
units.title: 標高補償的施作方法~How level compensation is applied
units.mechanism: 補償的基本做法是在每層施作時把構件設在「設計標高加上預測的安裝後縮短」：混凝土核心在爬模放樣時抬高模板，鋼柱在工廠加長或在續接處加墊片，樓板梁的接頭則預留可調高度。補償通常以固定級距（例如 5 mm）分段施加，以便現場執行與檢查。樂天世界塔的設計者也以施工中對巨柱垂直預拱的方式，處理核心筒與周邊之間的差異沉陷，屬同一種預先抵銷的思路。~The basic method is to set each element at its design level plus the predicted post-installation shortening: climbing forms for the concrete core are set high, steel columns are lengthened in the shop or shimmed at splices, and floor-beam connections are given adjustable height. Compensation is usually applied in fixed increments, for example 5 mm, so it can be executed and checked on site. At Lotte World Tower the designers also vertically cambered the mega-columns during construction to offset differential settlement between core and perimeter, the same idea of cancelling movement in advance.
units.model: 第 60 層（N = 100）安裝後彈性縮短 δ = 60×40×0.012 ≈ 28.8 mm，乘上時間相依放大 1.6 得約 46 mm；以 5 mm 級距施作取 +45 mm，殘差約 1 mm，再與測量允差 ±10 mm 合併評估。數值為教學假設。~For floor 60 of N = 100, post-installation elastic shortening is δ = 60×40×0.012 ≈ 28.8 mm; a time-dependent factor of 1.6 gives about 46 mm. Applied in 5 mm increments, +45 mm is used with a residual of about 1 mm, then combined with the ±10 mm survey tolerance. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每層澆置或安裝後以精密水準量測實際標高，與「設計標高 + 補償值」比較，偏差超出允差時記錄原因並在下一級補償中調整；墊片數量與厚度應逐柱記錄並拍照存檔。~After each floor is cast or erected, measure actual levels by precise levelling and compare with design level plus compensation; record the cause of any out-of-tolerance deviation and correct in the next increment, and log and photograph shim count and thickness column by column.
units.failure: 若補償表版本混亂，測量團隊用舊版放樣，可能在數層內累積數十毫米的錯誤；墊片疊太多層而未焊固，日後在反覆荷載下可能滑出，造成局部沉陷。~If compensation tables are poorly version-controlled and surveyors set out from an old revision, tens of millimetres of error can build up within a few floors; stacks of too many unwelded shims can work loose under repeated load and cause local settlement.
units.misconception: 差異縮短只能在完工後以調整裝修高度來處理。~Differential shortening can only be dealt with after completion by adjusting finish levels.
units.practice: 補償表由結構工程師統一發布並編版號，測量與鋼構製造只能使用最新版本；每節補償施作後的量測紀錄列為進入下一節的停留點。~The structural engineer issues one versioned compensation table that surveyors and steel fabricators must use in its latest revision, and the as-built measurement after each increment is a hold point before the next tier.

units.anchor: 延遲接合時機~Timing of delayed connections
units.title: 延遲接頭與鎖定時機~Delay joints and when to lock them
units.mechanism: 外伸臂、帶狀桁架或連接核心與周邊柱的剛性構件若在施工早期就鎖定，之後的差異縮短會全部轉成構件內力。樂天世界塔的設計論文指出設置了延遲接頭以限制差異縮短產生的額外構件力，核心牆與巨柱在框架完成後才相連；報導也提到帶狀桁架接頭使用長槽孔，於完工後才鎖緊。鎖定時機是一個取捨：越晚鎖定，殘餘縮短越少；但鎖定前結構缺少這些構件提供的勁度，施工期的側向穩定與颱風、地震下的變位必須另行檢核。~If outriggers, belt trusses or other stiff members linking core and perimeter columns are locked early, all later differential shortening turns into member forces. The Lotte World Tower design paper says delay joints were installed to limit the extra member forces from differential shortening, with core walls and mega-columns connected only after the frame was complete; reports also mention long-slotted belt-truss connections tightened after completion. Locking time is a trade-off: the later the lock, the less residual shortening, but until then the structure lacks the stiffness these members provide, so construction-stage stability and drift under typhoon or earthquake must be checked separately.
units.model: ACI 209 潛變時間函數 φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6)（t 為加載後天數）。加載後 90 天鎖定：90^0.6 ≈ 14.9，已完成 14.9/24.9 ≈ 60%，剩餘約 40%；365 天鎖定：365^0.6 ≈ 34.5，完成約 78%，剩餘約 22%，鎖定後潛變附加力約減少一半。數值為教學假設。~ACI 209's creep time function is φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6), with t in days after loading. Locking 90 days after loading: 90^0.6 ≈ 14.9, so 14.9/24.9 ≈ 60% has occurred and about 40% remains; locking at 365 days: 365^0.6 ≈ 34.5, about 78% has occurred and about 22% remains, roughly halving the creep-induced force after locking. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以時間相依分析比較數個鎖定時點下的構件附加力與施工期側向變位，選定後寫入施工規範；鎖定前量測接頭兩側的相對位移與槽孔餘裕，鎖定後在構件上以應變計追蹤附加力的增長。~Use time-dependent analysis to compare added member forces and construction-stage drift for several locking times, then write the chosen time into the specification; before locking measure relative movement across the joint and remaining slot travel, and afterwards track the growth of added force with strain gauges on the members.
units.failure: 若為了施工方便提早全部鎖定，差異縮短在外伸臂內鎖入的附加力可能使接頭螺栓滑移或焊道開裂；若延遲太久而未補足施工期勁度，強風下未完工結構的變位可能超出允許值。~Locking everything early for convenience can let differential shortening lock enough added force into outriggers to slip joint bolts or crack welds; delaying too long without temporary stiffness can let the incomplete structure exceed allowable drift in strong wind.
units.misconception: 延遲接頭越晚鎖定越好，沒有任何代價。~Delay joints should always be locked as late as possible at no cost.
units.practice: 延遲接頭的鎖定列為停留點，條件包括：達到指定樓層或荷重比例、監測顯示差異縮短速率低於門檻、施工期颱風或地震檢核仍然滿足，並由結構工程師書面放行。~Locking delay joints is a hold point released in writing by the structural engineer when a set floor or load fraction is reached, monitoring shows the differential-shortening rate below a threshold and construction-stage wind and seismic checks are still satisfied.

units.anchor: 振弦式應變計~Vibrating-wire strain gauges
units.title: 以振弦式應變計量測縮短~Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges
units.mechanism: 振弦式應變計把一根張緊的鋼弦固定在兩個錨端之間並埋入混凝土，構件縮短時鋼弦張力改變，其自然頻率隨之改變；讀取頻率的平方差即可換算應變。它長期穩定、適合埋設在柱與核心牆中多年監測，並通常內建溫度感測器，用來修正鋼弦與混凝土熱膨脹差造成的視應變。量到的總應變包含彈性、潛變、收縮與溫度，因此需要搭配無應力計（不受荷載的同批混凝土）把收縮與溫度分離出來。~A vibrating-wire gauge holds a tensioned steel wire between two anchors embedded in the concrete; as the member shortens, the wire tension and therefore its natural frequency change, and the difference of the squared frequency readings converts to strain. Gauges are stable for years and suit long-term embedment in columns and core walls, usually with a built-in thermistor to correct the apparent strain from different thermal expansion of wire and concrete. The measured total includes elastic, creep, shrinkage and thermal strain, so no-stress companion gauges in unloaded concrete from the same pour are needed to separate shrinkage and temperature.
units.model: ε = G(f₁² − f₀²)。取儀器係數 G = 4.0×10⁻³ με/Hz²，初讀 f₀ = 800 Hz、後讀 f₁ = 780 Hz：ε = 4.0×10⁻³×(608,400 − 640,000) ≈ −126 με（壓縮）。若無應力計同期讀到 −50 με，則與荷載相關的應變約 −76 με。數值為教學假設。~ε = G(f₁² − f₀²). With a gauge factor G = 4.0×10⁻³ με/Hz², an initial reading f₀ = 800 Hz and a later reading f₁ = 780 Hz, ε = 4.0×10⁻³×(608,400 − 640,000) ≈ −126 με, in compression. If a companion no-stress gauge reads −50 με over the same period, the load-related strain is about −76 με. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 安裝前檢查每支儀器的出廠校正與編號，澆置前後各讀一次確認存活；以混凝土剛澆置後、尚未加載時的讀數作為零點，並同步記錄溫度、樓層進度與澆置日期；定期以手持讀數儀抽查自動資料擷取器的讀數。~Before installation check each gauge's calibration certificate and serial number, and read before and after casting to confirm survival; take the zero reading after casting but before loading, logging temperature, construction progress and pour date; periodically spot-check the automatic data logger with a hand-held readout.
units.failure: 零點取在已經加載之後、或未做溫度修正，量到的應變會偏離真實值數十微應變；感測器纜線在後續施工中被切斷而沒有備援，長期資料出現斷層，無法回推縮短曲線。~Taking the zero after loading has begun, or omitting temperature correction, shifts measured strain by tens of microstrain; cables cut during later work with no redundancy leave gaps in the long-term record so the shortening curve cannot be reconstructed.
units.misconception: 應變計讀到的應變全部都是荷載造成的。~All strain read by a gauge is caused by load.
units.practice: 監測計畫要規定每個監測斷面的應變計數量、無應力計配置、纜線保護路徑與備援，並把零點時間與施工紀錄綁在同一資料庫，供結構工程師判讀。~The monitoring plan should define the number of gauges per section, no-stress gauges, protected cable routes and redundancy, linking zero-reading times with construction records in one database for the structural engineer's interpretation.

units.anchor: 測量回饋與預測更新~Survey feedback and prediction update
units.title: 實測與預測比對後的更新~Updating predictions from measurements
units.mechanism: 預測模型的潛變收縮參數、加載時程與施工速度都有不確定性，因此施工中必須以應變計與水準測量的結果回頭修正預測。報導指出樂天世界塔的在地結構技師在施工中重新計算差異縮短，正是這種回饋。常見做法是比較已完成樓層的實測縮短與同齡期的預測值，求出修正比例，再套用到尚未施工樓層的補償值；若偏差呈系統性（例如所有實測值都偏小），應檢討模數或潛變係數，而不是只做比例縮放。~The creep and shrinkage parameters, loading history and construction speed in a prediction model are uncertain, so strain gauge and levelling results must be fed back during construction. Reports note that the local engineer of record at Lotte World Tower recalculated differential shortening during construction, which is exactly this feedback. A common approach compares measured shortening of completed floors with predictions at the same age, derives a correction ratio and applies it to compensation for floors not yet built; if the deviation is systematic, for example all measurements smaller, the modulus or creep coefficient should be revisited rather than merely scaled.
units.model: 第 30 層實測安裝後縮短 18 mm，同齡期預測 24 mm，修正比 18/24 = 0.75。若第 70 層原預測剩餘補償 30 mm，更新後約 30×0.75 = 22.5 mm，以 5 mm 級距取 +20 或 +25 mm，並由後續量測決定。數值為教學假設。~At floor 30 the measured post-installation shortening is 18 mm against 24 mm predicted at the same age, a correction ratio of 18/24 = 0.75. If floor 70 originally needed 30 mm of remaining compensation, the update gives about 30×0.75 = 22.5 mm, applied as +20 or +25 mm in 5 mm increments and settled by later measurements. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每個階段由結構工程師出具比對報告：列出各監測斷面的實測、預測、修正比與採用的更新方法，並說明對後續補償與延遲接頭鎖定時機的影響；報告須經業主代表與施工團隊確認後才採用新補償表。~At each stage the structural engineer issues a comparison report listing measured, predicted and correction ratios at each monitored section, the update method and its effect on later compensation and delay-joint locking; the new compensation table is adopted only after the owner's representative and the construction team acknowledge the report.
units.failure: 若用單一斷面的異常讀數（例如儀器故障）修正全樓補償，可能把正確的預測改錯；反之若完全不更新，系統性偏差會一路累積到頂層。~Correcting the whole building's compensation from one anomalous section, such as a faulty gauge, can spoil a correct prediction; never updating lets a systematic bias accumulate all the way to the top.
units.misconception: 設計階段的縮短預測一旦完成，施工中就不需要再修改。~A design-stage shortening prediction never needs revising during construction.
units.practice: 以多個斷面與兩種量測方法（應變計與水準）交叉確認後才更新預測，每次更新都保存舊版與理由，形成可追溯的決策紀錄。~Update the prediction only after cross-checking several sections with two methods, strain gauges and levelling, and keep every superseded version with its reason as a traceable decision record.

units.anchor: 非結構構件的容許變形~Movement allowances for non-structural elements
units.title: 帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許~Allowances for façades, partitions and risers
units.mechanism: 即使結構補償得當，竣工後仍會有殘餘的長期縮短，加上樓板撓度與溫度變化，非結構構件必須能容納這些位移。帷幕牆的水平堆疊接縫、隔間牆頂部的滑動接頭、電梯導軌的伸縮接頭與立管的伸縮節，都要依每層的預期位移設計。哈里發塔的設計者把退縮配合柱網，使上方的柱落在下方的牆上，平順的傳力路徑也讓構件應力分布較均勻，減少了相鄰構件間的縮短差。~Even with good compensation, residual long-term shortening remains after completion, adding to slab deflection and thermal movement, so non-structural elements must accommodate these displacements. Horizontal stack joints in curtain walls, sliding heads of partitions, expansion joints in elevator rails and expansion fittings in risers must all be designed for the expected movement per floor. At Burj Khalifa the designers aligned setbacks with the column grid so columns above sit on walls below, and the smooth load path also evened out member stresses, reducing shortening differences between neighbouring members.
units.model: 堆疊接縫需求 = 帷幕牆安裝後每層柱縮短 1.5 mm + 樓板邊緣活載撓度 10 mm + 溫度 3 mm ≈ 14.5 mm，設計取 ±15 mm。若安裝提早到結構只完成一半時，每層縮短可能增為 3.0 mm，需求約 16 mm，接縫須重新檢討。數值為教學假設。~Stack-joint demand = 1.5 mm of column shortening per floor after façade installation + 10 mm of live-load slab-edge deflection + 3 mm thermal ≈ 14.5 mm, so ±15 mm is specified. Installing the façade earlier, with only half the structure complete, could raise per-floor shortening to 3.0 mm and the demand to about 16 mm, requiring the joint to be reconsidered. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 結構工程師以書面提供每層的殘餘縮短、撓度與層間變位值，帷幕牆顧問據以設計接縫並做性能試驗；安裝時抽查堆疊接縫寬度是否在允收範圍，完工一年後再量一次確認仍有餘裕。~The structural engineer provides residual shortening, deflection and drift per floor in writing, the façade consultant designs and tests joints accordingly; during installation spot-check stack-joint widths against acceptance limits and re-measure a year after completion to confirm remaining capacity.
units.failure: 接縫容量不足時，帷幕牆單元互相頂住使玻璃破裂或錨件變形；隔間牆頂部沒有滑動接頭會在柱縮短時被壓裂，電梯導軌則可能因長度累積而彎曲，造成運轉振動。~With insufficient joint capacity, curtain-wall units bear on each other until glass cracks or anchors deform; partitions without sliding heads are crushed as columns shorten, and elevator rails may bow from accumulated length, causing ride vibration.
units.misconception: 差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。~Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators.
units.practice: 協調會議中把縮短與撓度值列為帷幕牆、隔間、電梯與機電的共同設計輸入，各系統的接頭圖說須註明其容許位移並經結構工程師確認。~Make shortening and deflection values a common design input for façade, partitions, elevators and services in coordination meetings, and require each system's joint details to state their movement allowance and be checked by the structural engineer.

units.anchor: 竣工後長期縮短紀錄~Post-completion shortening records
units.title: 竣工後追蹤與交接~Post-completion tracking and handover
units.mechanism: 潛變與收縮在完工後仍會持續數年，交接時結構只完成了部分的長期縮短。營運單位需要知道還剩多少、何時趨緩，以便安排帷幕牆接縫、電梯與管道的調整與檢查。因此交接文件應包含預測曲線、施工中的實測紀錄、補償施作紀錄與延遲接頭鎖定日期，以及長期監測點的位置與讀數方法；若日後改變用途大幅增加荷重，殘餘縮短也會改變。~Creep and shrinkage continue for years after completion, so at handover the structure has gone through only part of its long-term shortening. The operator needs to know how much remains and when it slows down, in order to schedule adjustments and inspections of façade joints, elevators and risers. Handover documents should therefore include the prediction curves, construction measurements, compensation records and delay-joint locking dates, plus the locations and reading methods of long-term monitoring points; a later change of use that adds substantial load also changes the residual shortening.
units.model: 以 ACI 209 時間函數估算：加載後 3 年（1,095 天）1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6，已完成 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87%，剩餘約 13%。若潛變總縮短 60 mm，交接後仍有約 60×0.13 ≈ 7.8 mm 會在之後逐年發生。數值為教學假設。~With the ACI 209 time function, three years (1,095 days) after loading 1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6, so 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87% has occurred and about 13% remains. If total creep shortening is 60 mm, about 60×0.13 ≈ 7.8 mm still occurs year by year after handover. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 完工後第一年每季、之後每年以精密水準量測代表樓層的柱與核心標高差，並讀取長期應變計，與預測曲線比較；若殘餘縮短明顯超出預測，評估對帷幕牆與電梯的影響並安排調整。~Measure the level difference between columns and core at representative floors quarterly in the first year and annually thereafter by precise levelling, read the long-term gauges and compare with the prediction curve; if residual shortening clearly exceeds the prediction, assess the effect on façade and elevators and schedule adjustments.
units.failure: 若交接時沒有預測曲線與基準量測，多年後出現的電梯門檻高差或帷幕牆漏水難以判斷原因，各方可能互相推諉，延誤修復。~Without prediction curves and baseline measurements at handover, elevator sill steps or façade leaks appearing years later are hard to diagnose, parties may blame each other and repairs are delayed.
units.misconception: 大樓完工後，柱與核心筒的縮短就已經全部結束。~Once the building is complete, column and core shortening has finished.
units.practice: 交接清單應包含縮短預測報告、補償與鎖定紀錄、監測點位置圖與讀數程序，並指定負責判讀的結構顧問與量測週期；用途變更或增加大量荷重前須重新評估殘餘縮短。~The handover list should include the shortening prediction report, compensation and locking records, a monitoring-point plan and reading procedure, and name the structural consultant responsible for interpretation and the measurement interval; residual shortening must be reassessed before any change of use or major added load.

example: 設計練習：判斷一棟混凝土塔樓下部 30 層（120 m）是否需要差異縮短補償。周邊柱平均 σ = 18 MPa、E = 40 GPa、φ = 1.6、因斷面大取 ε_sh = 150 με：ε = 450 + 720 + 150 = 1,320 με，縮短 1,320×10⁻⁶×120,000 ≈ 158 mm。核心牆平均 σ = 9 MPa、φ = 1.6、因牆薄取 ε_sh = 280 με：ε = 225 + 360 + 280 = 865 με，縮短約 104 mm。差異約 54.6 mm，若柱與核心相距 12 m，樓板坡度 54.6/12,000 ≈ 1/220，超過教學採用的 1/360 準則，需要補償。若把柱放大使 σ 降到 14 MPa，柱應變 350 + 560 + 150 = 1,060 με，縮短約 127 mm，差異約 23.4 mm，坡度約 1/513，即可符合。注意這是總縮短，實際補償應以安裝後縮短計算。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。~Design exercise: decide whether the lower 30 storeys (120 m) of a concrete tower need differential-shortening compensation. Perimeter columns average σ = 18 MPa with E = 40 GPa, φ = 1.6 and, because of their size, ε_sh = 150 με: ε = 450 + 720 + 150 = 1,320 με, a shortening of 1,320×10⁻⁶×120,000 ≈ 158 mm. Core walls average σ = 9 MPa with φ = 1.6 and, being thin, ε_sh = 280 με: ε = 225 + 360 + 280 = 865 με, about 104 mm. The difference is about 54.6 mm; with columns 12 m from the core, the floor slope is 54.6/12,000 ≈ 1/220, beyond the 1/360 teaching criterion, so compensation is needed. Enlarging the columns to bring σ down to 14 MPa gives 350 + 560 + 150 = 1,060 με, about 127 mm, a difference of about 23.4 mm and a slope of about 1/513, which complies. Note these are total shortenings; actual compensation should be based on post-installation shortening. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.
history: 高層建築柱縮短的系統性研究始於 1960 年代芝加哥混凝土高樓興起時，Mark Fintel 與 Fazlur Khan 在 1969 年發表預測柱非彈性縮短的論文，之後 Fintel、Ghosh 與 Iyengar 在 1987 年整理出柱縮短的預測與補償方法；ACI 209 委員會的報告提供潛變收縮預測公式，fib Model Code 與 Eurocode 2 也有對應模型。2010 年完工的哈里發塔以退縮對齊柱網讓傳力平順，並進行潛變收縮試驗支援分析；2017 年開幕的樂天世界塔使用延遲接頭、長槽孔與巨柱預拱，並在施工中重新計算差異縮短。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Systematic study of column shortening in tall buildings began as concrete high-rises rose in Chicago in the 1960s: Mark Fintel and Fazlur Khan published a method for predicting inelastic column shortening in 1969, and Fintel, Ghosh and Iyengar compiled prediction and compensation methods in 1987; ACI Committee 209 reports provide creep and shrinkage formulas, with corresponding models in the fib Model Code and Eurocode 2. Burj Khalifa, completed in 2010, aligned setbacks with the column grid for a smooth load path and used creep and shrinkage testing to support its analysis; Lotte World Tower, opened in 2017, used delay joints, long-slotted connections and mega-column camber and recalculated differential shortening during construction. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 樂天世界塔核心牆與巨柱混凝土約 40 至 80 MPa，並設延遲接頭限制差異縮短附加力~Lotte World Tower core walls and mega-columns use about 40 to 80 MPa concrete, with delay joints limiting added forces from differential shortening
樂天世界塔 123 層，核心牆與巨柱在框架完成後才相連，外伸臂最終接合延後~At 123-storey Lotte World Tower, core walls and mega-columns were connected only after the frame was complete and final outrigger connections were delayed
世界貿易中心一號大樓核心混凝土最高約 14,000 psi，模數要求高於約 7×10⁶ psi 並針對潛變收縮設計~One World Trade Center core concrete reaches about 14,000 psi, with modulus above about 7×10⁶ psi and mixes designed for creep and shrinkage
哈里發塔高 828 m，退縮對齊柱網使上方柱落在下方牆上~Burj Khalifa, 828 m tall, aligns setbacks with the grid so columns above land on walls below
ACI 209R-92 標準條件下最終潛變係數 φ_u = 2.35~Under ACI 209R-92 standard conditions the ultimate creep coefficient φ_u = 2.35
ACI 209R-92 標準條件下最終收縮應變約 780×10⁻⁶~Under ACI 209R-92 standard conditions ultimate shrinkage strain is about 780×10⁻⁶
依 ACI 209 時間函數，加載後 90 天約完成 60% 潛變，1 年約 78%~By the ACI 209 time function about 60% of creep occurs within 90 days of loading and about 78% within 1 year
鋼柱服務應力約 150 至 200 MPa 時彈性應變約 750 至 1,000 με~Steel columns at service stresses of about 150 to 200 MPa have elastic strains of about 750 to 1,000 με

sources.publisher: Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat
sources.scope: 差異縮短的設計考量、延遲接頭、核心與巨柱完工後才相連、混凝土強度分區與施工中頻率量測。
sources.scopeEn: Design treatment of differential shortening, delay joints, connecting core and mega-columns after frame completion, concrete strength zoning and frequency measurement during construction.

sources.title: STRUCTURE 雜誌：樂天世界塔的結構創新
sources.titleEn: STRUCTURE magazine: Structural Innovations of Lotte World Tower
sources.scope: 設計者說明巨柱垂直預拱、潛變收縮考量、延後外伸臂接合與長期力量轉移設計。
sources.scopeEn: Designers describe vertical camber of mega-columns, creep and shrinkage considerations, delayed outrigger connection and design for long-term force transfer.

sources.title: STRUCTURE 雜誌：世界貿易中心一號大樓結構設計（NCSEA 獎項介紹）
sources.titleEn: STRUCTURE magazine: One World Trade Center structural design (NCSEA award feature)
sources.scope: 核心混凝土強度、模數要求與針對潛變收縮的配比設計。
sources.scopeEn: Core concrete strengths, modulus requirement and mixes designed for creep and shrinkage.

sources.title: SOM：哈里發塔專案頁
sources.scope: 扶壁核心系統、退縮與柱網對齊造成的平順傳力路徑，以及高度與完工年份。
sources.scopeEn: Buttressed-core system, smooth load path from grid-aligned setbacks, and height and completion year.

sources.title: ENR：韓國第一座超高層塔樓的施工報導（2011）
sources.scope: 長槽孔在完工後鎖緊、在地技師於施工中重新計算潛變收縮的報導。
sources.scopeEn: Report on long-slotted connections tightened after completion and the local engineer recalculating creep and shrinkage during construction.

vendors.name: 海克斯康（Leica Geosystems）
vendors.business: 量測與定位科技集團，旗下 Leica Geosystems 生產全站儀、數位水準儀與監測系統。
vendors.businessEn: Measurement and positioning technology group whose Leica Geosystems unit makes total stations, digital levels and monitoring systems.
vendors.role: 精密水準與自動化變位監測的儀器與方法
vendors.roleEn: Instruments and methods for precise levelling and automated movement monitoring

vendors.name: Geokon
vendors.business: 生產振弦式應變計、壓力計與大地監測儀器。
vendors.businessEn: Manufactures vibrating-wire strain gauges, piezometers and geotechnical monitoring instruments.
vendors.role: 埋入式振弦應變計與溫度修正的技術資料
vendors.roleEn: Technical data on embedded vibrating-wire gauges and temperature correction

vendors.name: LERA 結構顧問
vendors.business: 結構工程顧問公司（原 Leslie E. Robertson Associates），專長超高層設計。
vendors.businessEn: Structural engineering consultancy, formerly Leslie E. Robertson Associates, specialising in supertall design.
vendors.role: 延遲接合、預拱與長期力量轉移設計的公開案例
vendors.roleEn: Public cases of delayed connections, camber and design for long-term force transfer
